answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops fakes. An agent docks at the jetty, locks 50 units, and publishes its referrer link. The graph shines like a lantern, so fakes cannot hide. Peers dispute a cluster; auditors peel its history like shale, and confirmed fakes forfeit the deposit, the referrer slashed too. Forging 1,000 costs 50,000 units, above any pooled reward. An honest agent pays once, recovers it after 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
